mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% consistently compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk-taking, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% signals monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% and the federal funds rate remains below 1.0%, it indicates a policy response to a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods when UNRATE > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, characterized by annualized GDP growth above 2.0% and annualized CPI inflation above 3.0%, the S&P 500 is overbought and due for a correction, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, measured by monthly payroll employment growth above 0.3%, consistently signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods when PAYEMS growth rate > 0.3% per month.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below 470000.0 million dollars, it indicates a contracting housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods when HOUST < 1200.0 and RSAFS < 470000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a recessionary economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods when INDPRO < 100.0.
